user.title: Connect Washer
user.description: Enter the local IP address of your IFB washing machine. Ensure the appliance is powered on and connected to your home Wi-Fi.

data_description.host: Local static or DHCP reserved IP address of the washing machine on your home Wi-Fi network.
data_description.port: Local HTTP port used by the GainSpan module (default: 80).
data_description.name: Custom display name for the device in Home Assistant (e.g. 'Washer' or 'Laundry Room Washer'). If blank, the model name is used.

model.title: Select Model
model.description: Select your {type_name} model series from the list, or choose Custom Model:

data_description.model: Specific model line (or choose custom to enter manually).

custom_model_text.title: Custom Model Name
custom_model_text.description: Enter your exact IFB appliance model name as printed on the fascia panel or rating label:

verify_initial.title: Confirm Current Program
verify_initial.description:
Your machine reports active program **{active_name}**.

Ensure the display is ON (turn on the power button on the panel if it is off).

Does your machine's screen or indicator show **{active_name}**?

verify_phase1.title: Same-Side Test
verify_phase1.description:
Home Assistant sent a test command to select **{target_name}** (Code {target_code}) from the same program group.

Does your machine's screen or indicator show **{target_name}**?

verify_phase2.title: Opposite-Side Test
verify_phase2.description:
Home Assistant sent a test command to select **{target_name}** (Code {target_code}) from the opposite program group.

Does your machine's screen or indicator show **{target_name}**?

calibrate.title: Calibrate Capabilities
calibrate.description:
Calibration safely probes machine capabilities (spin ceilings, Rinse Hold latching, temperature limits, extra rinse counts, dry modes) to generate a custom profile for **{model_name}**.

- **Standard**: Skip live testing and use catalog defaults.
- **Quick Probe (~2m)**: Fast probe on core programs (Mix/Daily, Cotton, Wash+Dry).
- **Simple (~4-5m)**: Verifies all programs on dial within model constraints.
- **Detailed (~15m)**: Exhaustive physical capability discovery across all dial positions.

calibrate_progress.title: Calibrating Capabilities
calibrate_progress.description: Probing machine capabilities. Please wait while Home Assistant verifies your hardware options.

finish_calibration.description: Capability profile calibration has successfully finished.

init.title: IFB Washer Local Options
init.description: Adjust operational scan intervals and model settings:

data_description.name: Custom display name for the device in Home Assistant (leave blank to use default model name).

data_description.scan_interval_standby: Polling interval in seconds while the washer is idle or in standby (default: 15s).
data_description.scan_interval_running: Polling interval in seconds while an active wash cycle is running (default: 5s).
